title: 3 nabbed, P90,800 worth of ‘shabu’ seized in Caraga anti-drug ops

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police arrested three drug suspects and seized 13.36 grams of suspected shabu or crystal meth valued at P90,848 in separate buy-bust operations across the Caraga region on Thursday, Nov. 19, the Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) reported. In Barobo, Surigao del Sur, operatives from the Regional Drug Enforcement Unit 13 and the Barobo Municipal Police Station—in coordination with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) 13—apprehended a 35-year-old suspect identified only as alias “Jean” in Purok 1C Annex, Barangay Poblacion.
